title: Pull and Switch
area: 50m x 36m, a goal at the right hand end (7m wide)
kit: Red and Blue bibs, keeper in a third colour, balls in the goal
start: Blue start with the ball deep, Red defend with five

steps.say: Blue build slowly. B1 plays to B3 and Red hold their line.
steps.vo: Blue start deep. B1 plays into B3. Be patient, Red hold their line, and Blue want them to move.

steps.say: PULL: B3 plays wide to B2. Red shuffle across to follow the ball.
steps.vo: Now pull them across. B3 plays wide to B2 on the left, and Red shuffle across to follow the ball. They are all looking at it.

steps.say: Keep pulling. B2 plays back inside to B4. Red are now all on one side.
steps.vo: Keep pulling. B2 plays it back inside to B4. Red are now bunched on the left, with a huge gap on the right.

steps.say: SWITCH: B4 hits the long pass to B5. Red are too far over.
steps.vo: Switch. B4 looks up and hits the long pass to B5 on the far side. Red are too far over to get across in time.

steps.say: B5 goes first time to B7 who has stayed high and wide.
steps.vo: B5 takes one touch, and plays first time into B7, who stayed high and wide and waited for this moment.

steps.say: B7 drives in, B6 arrives at the far post. Shot.
steps.vo: B7 drives forward. R4 is too late. B6 arrives at the far post, and B7 shoots at goal.

setup: Blue have 7 players (B1 to B7) against Red 5 (R1 to R5) and a Red keeper.
B6 and B7 stay high and wide as the finishers.
Two wide channels are marked, the pull side and the switch side.
rules: Blue must make at least three passes on one side before they can switch.
Blue can only shoot after a switch of play.
Red score by winning the ball and passing it to a neutral target on the halfway line.
Swap which side is the pull side each round.
restart: Ball out of play or save: Blue restart from B1.
Red win it: play to the target, then restart.
points: Pull first: draw them in with short passes, then hit the space.
Look before you receive: where is the free player?
Hit it early and with pace. A slow switch gives them time to slide.
Stay wide and high: the far player must wait and be patient.
progress: Make it 7v6 so Red can recover faster.
Switch must be played in under two touches.
Play with two goals: score after a switch and you get double.
